name: Meilisearch
description: Protects against destructive Meilisearch REST API operations like index deletion, \ document deletion, delete-batch, and API key removal.

destructive_patterns.name: meili-curl-delete-document
destructive_patterns.description: curl -X DELETE against /documents/{id} removes a document from Meilisearch.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a single document removes it from search results immediately. While \ less destructive than bulk operations, applications expecting this document \ will receive errors or empty results.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - GET /indexes/{uid}/documents/{id}: Verify document first \ - Export document content before deletion \ - Use soft delete field in documents instead

destructive_patterns.name: meili-curl-delete-documents
destructive_patterns.description: curl -X DELETE against /documents removes documents from Meilisearch.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting all documents removes every record from the index while preserving \ settings and configuration. Search will return no results until re-indexing. \ This cannot be undone.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - GET /indexes/{uid}/documents: Export documents first \ - Create a snapshot or dump before deletion \ - Use delete-batch for targeted removal instead

destructive_patterns.name: meili-curl-delete-batch
destructive_patterns.description: curl -X POST to /documents/delete-batch deletes documents in bulk.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Batch delete removes multiple documents by their IDs in a single operation. \ This is irreversible and affects all documents matching the provided IDs. \ Verify the ID list carefully before executing.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - GET documents by ID to verify content first \ - Export matching documents before deletion \ - Test with a small batch before processing all

destructive_patterns.name: meili-curl-delete-key
destructive_patterns.description: curl -X DELETE against /keys removes a Meilisearch API key.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting an API key immediately revokes access for all applications using it. \ Search and indexing operations will fail with authentication errors. The key \ cannot be recovered after deletion.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - GET /keys: List and document keys before deletion \ - Create replacement key before deleting old one \ - Update applications with new key first

destructive_patterns.name: meili-curl-delete-index
destructive_patterns.description: curl -X DELETE against /indexes/{uid} deletes a Meilisearch index.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a Meilisearch index permanently removes all documents, settings, \ filterable attributes, and ranking rules. Search functionality for applications \ using this index will fail immediately.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - GET /indexes/{uid}: Export index settings first \ - Create a dump with POST /dumps for backup \ - Re-index from source data after verification
